cases.title: Client probe
cases.purpose: The client opens its window and GLES 2 context, draws a triangle, reads the pixel back and exits 0, as the Home takeover's install gate needs.
steps: Run on the TV: cd APP && env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/tmp/xdg timeout 40 /usr/bin/jailer -t native_devmode -i com.tvweb.dashboard -p APP APP/nativetv-tv --probe; echo exit=$?
Read the exit code and the last JSON line of the output.

cases.title: Client probe, GL error forced
cases.purpose: The probe reports a GL fault as exit 12 (NATIVETV_PROBE_FAULT=gl-error).
steps: Run on the TV: cd APP && env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/tmp/xdg NATIVETV_PROBE_FAULT=gl-error timeout 40 /usr/bin/jailer -t native_devmode -i com.tvweb.dashboard -p APP APP/nativetv-tv --probe; echo exit=$?
Read the exit code and the last JSON line of the output.

cases.title: Client probe, wrong pixel forced
cases.purpose: The probe reports a frame that did not draw as exit 13 (NATIVETV_PROBE_FAULT=readback).
steps: Run on the TV: cd APP && env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/tmp/xdg NATIVETV_PROBE_FAULT=readback timeout 40 /usr/bin/jailer -t native_devmode -i com.tvweb.dashboard -p APP APP/nativetv-tv --probe; echo exit=$?
Read the exit code and the last JSON line of the output.

cases.title: Kit gallery: home
cases.purpose: The design gallery screen home draws on the real GPU within the render limits and the client exits 0 with a capture.
steps: Take the lock folder /tmp/nativetv-e2e.lock (mkdir) and check that no nativetv-tv is running (pidof).
Read the server's port: /var/lib/tvweb/native/nativetv-service port --data-root /var/lib/tvweb (the access token is never read).

Run: cd APP && env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/tmp/xdg timeout 18 /usr/bin/jailer -t native_devmode -i com.tvweb.dashboard -p APP APP/nativetv-tv '{"@system_native_app":true,"nid":"com.tvweb.dashboard"}' --server http://127.0.0.1:PORT --screen kit:home --duration-ms 3000 --perf /tmp/nativetv-e2e-ID.perf.jsonl --capture /tmp/nativetv-e2e-ID.ppm --report /tmp/nativetv-e2e-ID.report.json
Read the perf log, the report and the size of the capture, and judge them against the criteria.
Delete the temporary files and the lock folder.

cases.title: Home takeover on
cases.purpose: Switching Native Tv Home on takes LG's Home's place: the switch is accepted (the client is on the home screen and passes its probe), nothing is halted, and the stub is mounted.
steps: Take the lock folder /tmp/nativetv-e2e.lock (mkdir).
Read the server's port: /var/lib/tvweb/native/nativetv-service port --data-root /var/lib/tvweb (the access token is never read).
Send scripts/home-flow.js with this case's flow to the TV's Node over ssh (node - PORT); it calls the server on the TV's loopback and reads the app in front from the app manager.
Run: POST /api/home/enable, wait 1.5 s, then GET /api/home and check enabled, active (the stub is mounted) and nativeHome.halted false.
Judge each step; the first that fails ends the flow.
Delete the lock folder.

cases.title: Home and Back on Native Tv Home

Run: check Home is on; send Home, give the stub 1.5 s to come and go, and wait for com.tvweb.dashboard within 5 s (the stub is LG's Home's id while Home is on, so a read taken before it arrives would pass at once and the stub then fail the check that follows); send Back and check it stays 3 s; send Home again, wait the same, check it is back within 5 s and stays 3 s; check nativeHome.halted is false and no exit was counted.

cases.title: Sound output row is the output the TV is using
cases.purpose: The Advanced tab's Sound output reads the LG settings route. The settings service keeps the last HDMI ARC pick in `settings.soundOutput` while the TV plays through its speaker; the output in use is `dimension.soundOutput`, and the row must show that one.
steps: Take the lock folder /tmp/nativetv-e2e.lock (mkdir).
Read the server's port: /var/lib/tvweb/native/nativetv-service port --data-root /var/lib/tvweb (the access token is never read).
Under the TV's Node, over ssh: GET /api/lgsettings?section=sound from 127.0.0.1 (loopback needs no token).
Compare the soundOutput row's value with dimensions.sound.soundOutput of the same reply.
Remove the lock folder.
